section_header: STEERING — Steering Column Assembly with Tilt Steering
title: ASSEMBLY OF STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY AND TILT MECHANISM
ocr_text:
ASSEMBLY OF STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY
AND TILT MECHANISM
(See page SR-5)

1. COAT ALL RUBBING PARTS WITH MP GREASE

2. ASSEMBLE PAWL SET BOLT
   Torque: 185 kg·cm (13 ft·lb, 18 N·m)

3. ASSEMBLE TILT LEVER TO SUPPORT
   (a) Select a collar No. 1 which will eliminate all play.

   Outer diameter                mm (in.)
   17.989 — 17.996      (0.7082 — 0.7085)
   17.996 — 18.003      (0.7085 — 0.7088)
   18.003 — 18.010      (0.7088 — 0.7091)
   18.010 — 18.017      (0.7091 — 0.7093)
   18.017 — 18.024      (0.7093 — 0.7096)

   (b) Install tilt lever and collar No. 1 to the support.
   (c) Select a collar No. 2 which will eliminate all play.

   Outer diameter                mm (in.)
   17.982 — 18.000      (0.7080 — 0.7087)
   18.000 — 18.018      (0.7087 — 0.7094)

   (d) Install collar No. 2 to the support.

   (e) Drive the serration bolt into the support.

   (f) Install the tilt pawl, tension spring and the release
       pin.
